test_unknown_fields_serialization: test that unknown fields are preserved when serializing protobuf messages to and from strings
test_discard_unknown_fields: test the DiscardUnknownFields method to remove all unknown fields from a protobuf message
test_merge_unknown_fields: test merging two protobuf messages where unknown fields are correctly combined and preserved
test_unknown_enum_values: test that unknown enum values are stored as unknown fields and return default values when accessed
test_unknown_fields_accessors: test the UnknownFields accessor to inspect field numbers, wire types, and raw data of unknown fields
